statement: Between 2026-09-06 and 2026-09-26, US forces strike, disable, or destroy at least one additional Iranian oil tanker or crude carrier, as announced by US Central Command.
resolution: TRUE if a US Central Command statement dated 2026-09-06 to 2026-09-26, carried by Reuters, AP, or AFP, reports a US strike on at least one Iranian oil tanker or crude carrier in that window, excluding the three struck 2026-09-05.
failure_condition: No US strike on any Iranian oil tanker or crude carrier other than the three struck on 2026-09-05 occurs between 2026-09-06 and 2026-09-26.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: Between 2026-09-05 and 2026-10-03, the governments of Russia and Ukraine both publicly confirm a general ceasefire or cessation-of-hostilities agreement covering the entire front line.
resolution: TRUE if, between 2026-09-05 and 2026-10-03, official statements from both the Kremlin and the Ukrainian presidency confirm a front-wide ceasefire agreement, reported by Reuters or AP. Partial truces (energy, Black Sea, humanitarian pauses) do not count.
failure_condition: No front-wide ceasefire agreement is confirmed by both the Russian and Ukrainian governments between 2026-09-05 and 2026-10-03.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: The AfD wins an absolute majority of seats in the Saxony-Anhalt Landtag election held on 2026-09-06, per the official preliminary result.

failure_condition: The official preliminary result shows the AfD with half or fewer of all Landtag seats.
